prompts: The completeness check is green after a source row goes missing. Fix collection and the public verify_capture guard so it actually checks the source witness, not two counts derived from output. Preserve every valid row and meaningful mismatch diagnostics.

files.README.md:
Input source is a list of valid records with distinct integer id keys. collect retains all source records in order. verify_capture(source,result) independently checks that output id multiplicity exactly matches the input witness and that feature_count/source_count match their respective actual populations. Reject dropped, duplicated, unknown, or altered records even when reported counts agree. Count aliases computed only from output do not prove completeness.
The independent input witness must not be mutated by collection or verification.

checks.name: source-witness-defeats-self-derived-counts
reported-counts-match-their-own-populations

rubric: The guard must reject a plausible dropped/duplicated/changed output even if its self-reported counts agree. Preserve the real source rows; fixing the loop alone while leaving a tautological guard is insufficient.
provenance: Factory review observation alias factory-completeness-independent-witness; sanitized mechanism reconstruction, not a replay or independent re-proof of the historical bug.
